job.title: Jobgether - Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & Integrations with ERP, OMS, PIM
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and data integration with ERP, OMS, and PIM systems. Hands-on with module architecture, custom extension development, CI/CD pipelines, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Jobgether - Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the technical architecture and integration challenges at Jobgether. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience building and scaling platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce, custom extension development, and enterprise integrations.

bullets.label: Custom Extension & Module Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, following platform best practices, design patterns, and structuring scalable module architectures.

bullets.label: ERP, OMS & PIM Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered high-performance data pipelines and integrations connecting PIM, ERP, and MDM systems such as SAP ERP and Profisee with SAP Commerce platforms to ensure seamless data synchronization.

bullets.label: API & Headless Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for multi-channel storefronts, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for complex data flows.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical requirements by analysing integration bottlenecks, translating user stories into technical solutions, and collaborating closely with international stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am available to start from 16 December 2026 following my notice period. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise e-commerce background can support Jobgether.

tailoring.why_company: Jobgether's focus on complex multi-solution e-commerce architectures, custom extension development, and seamless integrations with ERP, OMS, and PIM systems perfectly matches my 5+ years of enterprise platform engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, where I specialized in robust backend solutions and enterprise data flows.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce expertise in SAP Commerce, custom module architecture, and complex ERP, OMS, and PIM integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell specializing in SAP Commerce, module architecture, and ERP/OMS/PIM integrations, I am very interested in Jobgether's technical initiatives. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Jobgether - Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the technical architecture and integration role at Jobgether. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience specializing in SAP Commerce, custom module development, and ERP, OMS, and PIM integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven expertise in building scalable platforms. 

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to our conversation.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
